hooks.name: Engine change needs property tests
hooks.description: Reminds the agent that engine/ changes require hypothesis + pytest tests.

action.prompt: You changed a file in engine/. Per .kiro/steering/testing.md, every engine change needs BOTH a hypothesis property test and a pytest unit test under tests/engine/. If they are missing or do not cover the change, add them now, citing the property id (P1, P2...) from the spec design.md. Keep engine/ pure (no I/O, no LLM, no clock).
